resources.string: Paired devices request each other’s location via encrypted SMS. No internet or cloud needed, but mobile network coverage is. Each SMS is charged according to your plan and may show up as unreadable text in your SMS app. After a reboot, a device only replies once it has been unlocked. This feature does not replace an emergency call (112).
✅ This device is set up to answer requests
⚠️ This device has no telephony/SMS support
No battery optimisation for this app
Keep permissions when app is unused
In app info, turn off the option that removes permissions or pauses app activity if the app is unused. Name and position depend on the Android version.

So that your device can answer a request while you are not using it, select “Allow all the time” for location. For SMS locate, the location is only determined when a valid request from a paired device arrives (otherwise only for features you start yourself).

If the permission is greyed out or no prompt appears, Android may be restricting it for apps installed from outside an app store:

1. Open app info
2. Menu (⋮) top right → “Allow restricted settings”
3. Permissions → allow SMS or location

Names and steps depend on manufacturer and Android version.
No matching app or setting found.
No map or navigation app found. For use without internet, install an app with offline maps (e.g. OsmAnd or Organic Maps).
No paired device yet. Choose “New pairing” on one device, then scan the QR code or enter the code on the other.
Enter phone numbers with country code if possible (e.g. +49 …) so that SMS also work abroad.
Phone number of the other device
Your name (shown on the other device)
This device may request my location by SMS at any time. The reply is sent automatically without asking.
Please check the number: replies are only sent to this number.

Scan or type this on the other device. The code is the secret key: only pass it on in person or through a trusted channel. Pairing is complete once the other device has accepted it. Then send a test request from both devices.
Scan the pairing QR code of the other device
Invalid pairing code. Please check your input.
This code was created on this device. It must be accepted on the other device.
Pairing saved. Send a test request to verify.
Remove pairing with %1$s? No requests are possible in either direction until you pair again.

One SMS will be sent to %1$s. The other device replies with up to two SMS. A fresh GPS fix can take a few minutes. Further requests are answered after 1 minute at the earliest and at most 6 times per hour.
Request not sent. Check coverage and SIM, then try again.
Last known position received, fresh fix to follow
The other device could not determine a location
Location services are off on the other device
The other device lacks location permission
Last known location of %1$s received, a fresh one will follow.
%1$s could not get a fresh fix. Last known location received.
Determining location for a paired device
%1$s requested your location. Not answered because sharing is off.
Request from %1$s discarded: older than 24 hours or wrong device clock.
Request from %1$s discarded: too many requests in a short time.
Location reply to %1$s handed to the system (sending not confirmed).
Location reply to %1$s could not be sent.
Key for %1$s unreadable. Please pair again.
